subject: Can I apply survey weights with QMCEM estimation?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Can I apply survey weights with QMCEM estimation?
parts:
Hi Phil,

I want to test survey weights within national competency testlet. I want to use QMCEM estimation for the testlet (high dimensional) model, but I can't. Can I apply survey weights with QMCEM?

Seongho
